model.tools_commit: each entry's call, run again by site re-capture on armada

note: Each image is one call (see call); key is the sampling key (the old seed). The set was chosen from RTX 4080 draws of revision 3664c055 for having no white or black bands, and clip_score and aesthetic were measured on those draws. These are the same calls run again on CPU at 403c4215: they differ from the chosen draws in detail, and p2_k32 now has white side bands.
